{{Quote|This lab has had a creature containment failure. They have overrun the facility. I don't know if there are survivors or not.|[[Jana T'bayr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Adaptive Biology|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''GeneTech Syndicate Lab''' was a laboratory owned by the [[GeneTech Syndicate]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Now that you have confirmed this as the site of the original experiment, we can conclude the queen might still be here.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:G" />}}
The GeneTech Syndicate Lab was located on the planet Talus, just outside the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]]. Although it was listed as engaging in legitimate genetic manipulation on animals, the GeneTech Syndicate used this laboratory to conduct illegal experiments. While a building is visible from the surface, most of the laboratory is located underground.<ref name="SWG:G" />

==History==
{{Quote|A CorSec scout team found a lab owned by the Genetech Syndicate undergoing an emergency evacuation. This is a good place to check for the queen arachne.|Agent Taarna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:G" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the GeneTech Syndicate was secretly developing an illegal and dangerous [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project in the GeneTech Syndicate Lab, Dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]], the objective was to create an intelligent and deadly form of [[arachne]]s for the use of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:G" /> The project was led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vigh]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|chief scientist]] of the GeneTech Syndicate.<ref name="GP">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66911&resource=features|text=Genetic Potential}}</ref>

[[File:Arachne_Queen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Arachne queen in the deepest level of the lab.]]
However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the arachnes overwhelmed their creators and slaughtered most of the staff of the lab. The Genetech Syndicate issued an emergency evacuation of the laboratory and all the surviving scientists quickly fled to avoid being arrested and charged with illegal biological experiments.<ref name="SWG:G" /> [[Jana T'bayr]] was the sole scientist to remain in the lab. She initially wanted to save the project but she then tried to find a way to prevent the parasophic arachnes from destroying the planet Talus.<ref name="SWG:AB" />

[[File:AdaptiveBiology-GH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Spacers discovering the queen's mate.]]
The [[Corellian Security Force]] eventually discovered the situation and dispatched a CorSec crew to clear the lab.<ref name="SWG:AB" /> [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] dispatched spacers to eliminate the creatures in the lab.<ref name="SWG:PfP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Plea for Pity|Talus}}</ref> With the help of [[6-POC]], the project manager's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], the spacers managed to delete all scientific data that could be used to restart the program.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "A Better Life Through Genetics" on Talus</ref> They also retrieved a self-destruct intron virus, a virus designed specifically by the GeneTech Syndicate scientists to kill the arachnes. The spacers applied this virus to every arachne [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] they found in the lab.<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find the Source|Talus}}</ref> Agent Taarna later tasked the spacer to eliminate the arachne queen, the arachne responsible for breeding the parasophic arachnes. The spacers found the queen, a gigantic arachne, at the lowest level of the lab and finally killed her. Taarna thought that the new arachne species was doomed with the death of the queen.<ref name="SWG:G" /> However, Jana T'bayr revealed that another arachne, the queen's mate, was still posing a threat. The queen's mate was much larger and stronger than other arachnes and designed for combat. Furthermore, if the queen's mate was the only arachne left, he could morph into a breeder and could repopulate the species by himself. A group of spacers found the queen's mate in another part of the lab and, after an intense fight, managed to kill the dreadful creature.<ref name="SWG:AB" /> The destruction of all the breeding arachnes and eggs eliminated the Parasophic Arachne threat.<ref name="SWG:G" />

==Behind the scenes==
The GeneTech Syndicate Lab was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:G" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The GeneTech Syndicate Lab was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Genocide|Deifying Decisions]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
